name: Tencent Hunyuan 3D Auto Rigging (Tencent Cloud TC3)
description: Tencent Cloud TC3-signed Hunyuan 3D auto-rigging preset (SubmitAutoRiggingJob/DescribeAutoRiggingJob). Enter SecretId:SecretKey after importing. The Hunyuan rigging API has no model parameter (only File3D + MotionType), so this preset sets response_config.no_model_selector=true to hide the model dropdown in the workspace; vendors with real model variants (e.g. UniRig) should omit this flag. MotionType semantics are vendor-specific: this preset declares them under response_config.motion_types as [{value, label}] — value is the numeric id sent to the vendor, label is the Chinese name shown in the UI. Other vendors should declare their own motion_types (or omit it to fall back to generic numeric placeholders).

connectors.name: Tencent Hunyuan Auto Rigging
connectors.request_template: {"File3D":{"Url":"{{ image_url }}","Type":"{{ FileType | default('GLB') }}"}{% if MotionType %},"MotionType":{{ MotionType }}{% endif %}}
connectors.description: Auto-rigging for humanoid 3D models (A-Pose/T-Pose, no weapons/mounts/wings). Input File3D must be a publicly reachable FBX/GLB URL (<=60MB). Omit MotionType for skeleton-only rigging, or pass MotionType 1-48 to bind one preset motion (idle/walk/run/dance etc.). Result URLs expire in 1 day; JobId expires in 24h. API Key format: SecretId:SecretKey.
